## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 is internally inconsistent: it says the \((2,2)\) identity was not obtained, but the Strategy supplies a correct five-row Pieri certificate for it.
- claim-2 correctly identifies the \((3,3)\) target as \(\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\), but gives no identity proving it lies in \(A_+J\).
- Complete truncated-Pieri expansions and coefficientwise cancellations are not supplied for all ten \(\rho\subseteq3^2\). The earlier formulas with only sample expansions do not meet this criterion.
- Global definitions of \(L_\rho\) and \(R_{\rho'}\), together with the \(\rho=\varnothing\) boundary case, are not restated in the proof certificate.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Supply the complete ten-case certificate, including an explicit integral identity for \(\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\), and full truncated-Pieri expansions verifying every coefficient, cancellation, \(1\le t\le5\), and \(333\subseteq\lambda_k\subseteq5^5\).
